'use strict';

// Unit tests for lib/init-commit.js, the helpers behind `atris init` that commit
// only the setup files init wrote. Each test runs real git inside a throwaway repo
// under os.tmpdir(). HOME and the global git config point at a temp folder, so the
// developer's own git settings cannot change the result.

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');
const {
  snapshotBeforeInit,
  commitInitFiles,
  dirtyPaths,
  isLocalOnly,
} = require('../lib/init-commit');

const ATRIS_AUTHOR = 'Atris <299057014+atris-builder[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>';
const IDENTITY_VARS = ['GIT_AUTHOR_NAME', 'GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL', 'GIT_COMMITTER_NAME', 'GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL'];
const ISOLATED_VARS = ['HOME', 'GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM', 'GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL', ...IDENTITY_VARS];

// The module spawns git with the inherited environment, so the isolation has to
// live in process.env. It is restored after each test.
function isolateGit(t) {
  const base = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'atris-init-commit-lib-'));
  const saved = Object.fromEntries(ISOLATED_VARS.map((key) => [key, process.env[key]]));
  t.after(() => {
    for (const key of ISOLATED_VARS) {
      if (saved[key] === undefined) delete process.env[key];
      else process.env[key] = saved[key];
    }
    fs.rmSync(base, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });
  // useConfigOnly stops git from building an identity out of the login name and hostname,
  // so a repo with no identity set fails the way it does on a fresh machine.
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(base, 'gitconfig'), '[user]\n\tuseConfigOnly = true\n');
  process.env.HOME = base;
  process.env.GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM = '1';
  process.env.GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL = path.join(base, 'gitconfig');
  for (const key of IDENTITY_VARS) delete process.env[key];
  return base;
}

function makeRepo(t) {
  const base = isolateGit(t);
  const root = path.join(base, 'repo');
  fs.mkdirSync(root);
  const git = (args) => {
    const r = spawnSync('git', args, { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8' });
    assert.strictEqual(r.status, 0, r.stderr || r.stdout);
    return r.stdout;
  };
  git(['init', '-q', '-b', 'master']);
  const write = (rel, body = 'x\n') => {
    const full = path.join(root, rel);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(full), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(full, body);
  };
  // Commits whatever is staged, so the repo has history afterwards.
  const commit = (message) => {
    git(['-c', 'user.name=Test User', '-c', 'user.email=test@example.com', 'commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', message]);
  };
  return { base, root, git, write, commit };
}

test('isLocalOnly flags machine-local config files and nothing else', () => {
  assert.strictEqual(isLocalOnly('.devin/config.local.json'), true);
  assert.strictEqual(isLocalOnly('app.local'), true);
  assert.strictEqual(isLocalOnly('atris/MAP.md'), false);
  assert.strictEqual(isLocalOnly('notes/locals.md'), false);
});

test('dirtyPaths lists changed and untracked files, and a rename by its new name only', (t) => {
  const repo = makeRepo(t);
  assert.strictEqual(dirtyPaths(repo.root).size, 0);

  repo.write('old.md');
  repo.git(['add', 'old.md']);
  repo.commit('seed');
  repo.git(['mv', 'old.md', 'new.md']);
  repo.write('draft/a.md');

  assert.deepStrictEqual([...dirtyPaths(repo.root)].sort(), ['draft/a.md', 'new.md']);
});

test('snapshotBeforeInit and commitInitFiles do nothing outside a git repo', (t) => {
  const base = isolateGit(t);
  assert.strictEqual(snapshotBeforeInit(base), null);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(commitInitFiles(null), { committed: false, reason: 'not_git' });
});

test('a fresh repo commits only the files init wrote and leaves the person\'s work alone', (t) => {
  const repo = makeRepo(t);
  repo.write('notes.md', 'my unsaved notes\n');
  repo.write('staged.md', 'my staged draft\n');
  repo.git(['add', 'staged.md']);

  const snapshot = snapshotBeforeInit(repo.root);
  assert.strictEqual(snapshot.fresh, true);
  assert.ok(snapshot.before.has('notes.md'));
  assert.ok(snapshot.before.has('staged.md'));

  repo.write('CLAUDE.md', '# claude\n');
  repo.write('atris/MAP.md', '# map\n');
  repo.write('.devin/config.local.json', '{}\n');

  const result = commitInitFiles(snapshot);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(result, { committed: true, paths: ['CLAUDE.md', 'atris/MAP.md'] });

  // Only the init files reached history. The local-only config and the person's files did not.
  assert.deepStrictEqual(repo.git(['ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', 'HEAD']).split('\n').filter(Boolean), ['CLAUDE.md', 'atris/MAP.md']);
  assert.strictEqual(repo.git(['rev-list', '--count', 'HEAD']).trim(), '1');
  assert.deepStrictEqual(
    repo.git(['status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all']).split('\n').filter(Boolean).sort(),
    ['?? .devin/config.local.json', '?? notes.md', 'A  staged.md'],
  );
});

test('with no git identity configured, the commit falls back to the Atris author', (t) => {
  const repo = makeRepo(t);
  const snapshot = snapshotBeforeInit(repo.root);
  repo.write('CLAUDE.md', '# claude\n');

  assert.strictEqual(commitInitFiles(snapshot).committed, true);
  assert.strictEqual(repo.git(['log', '-1', '--format=%an <%ae>']).trim(), ATRIS_AUTHOR);
});

test('a repo with history is left alone', (t) => {
  const repo = makeRepo(t);
  repo.commit('existing work');
  const snapshot = snapshotBeforeInit(repo.root);
  assert.strictEqual(snapshot.fresh, false);

  repo.write('CLAUDE.md', '# claude\n');
  assert.deepStrictEqual(commitInitFiles(snapshot), { committed: false, reason: 'has_history' });
  assert.strictEqual(repo.git(['rev-list', '--count', 'HEAD']).trim(), '1');
});

test('a fresh repo with no new files reports nothing_new', (t) => {
  const repo = makeRepo(t);
  repo.write('notes.md', 'mine\n');
  const snapshot = snapshotBeforeInit(repo.root);

  assert.deepStrictEqual(commitInitFiles(snapshot), { committed: false, reason: 'nothing_new', paths: [] });
});

test('a commit blocked by a hook is reported and the index is put back as found', (t) => {
  const repo = makeRepo(t);
  const snapshot = snapshotBeforeInit(repo.root);
  repo.write('CLAUDE.md', '# claude\n');

  const hook = path.join(repo.root, '.git', 'hooks', 'pre-commit');
  fs.writeFileSync(hook, '#!/bin/sh\necho "blocked by test hook" >&2\nexit 1\n');
  fs.chmodSync(hook, 0o755);

  const result = commitInitFiles(snapshot);
  assert.strictEqual(result.committed, false);
  assert.strictEqual(result.reason, 'commit_failed');
  assert.deepStrictEqual(result.paths, ['CLAUDE.md']);
  assert.match(result.detail, /blocked by test hook/);

  assert.strictEqual(repo.git(['diff', '--cached', '--name-only']).trim(), '');
  assert.ok(fs.existsSync(path.join(repo.root, 'CLAUDE.md')));
});

const journal = require('../lib/journal');

test('timestamps match only when valid and less than five milliseconds apart', () => {
  const base = '2026-10-23T12:00:00.000Z';
  assert.strictEqual(journal.isSameTimestamp(base, base), true);
  assert.strictEqual(journal.isSameTimestamp(base, '2026-10-23T12:00:00.004Z'), true);
  assert.strictEqual(journal.isSameTimestamp('2026-10-23T12:00:00.004Z', base), true);
  assert.strictEqual(journal.isSameTimestamp(base, '2026-10-23T12:00:00.005Z'), false);
  assert.strictEqual(journal.isSameTimestamp(base, 'invalid'), false);
  assert.strictEqual(journal.isSameTimestamp('', base), false);
  assert.strictEqual(journal.isSameTimestamp(base, null), false);
});

test('content hashing uses SHA-256 and normalizes CRLF line endings', () => {
  assert.strictEqual(journal.computeContentHash('abc'),
    'ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad');
  assert.strictEqual(journal.computeContentHash('one\r\ntwo\r\n'),
    journal.computeContentHash('one\ntwo\n'));
  assert.notStrictEqual(journal.computeContentHash('one\ntwo'),
    journal.computeContentHash('one\ntwo\n'));
  for (const value of [undefined, null, 42, {}, []]) {
    assert.strictEqual(journal.computeContentHash(value), null);
  }
});

test('journal parsing retains headings, preamble, and nested headings', () => {
  assert.deepStrictEqual(journal.parseJournalSections(
    '# Daily log\n\n## Notes\nA note\n### Detail\nMore\n## Inbox\nAn idea\n'
  ), {
    __header__: '# Daily log\n',
    Notes: '## Notes\nA note\n### Detail\nMore',
    Inbox: '## Inbox\nAn idea\n',
  });
  assert.deepStrictEqual(journal.parseJournalSections(''), { __header__: '' });
});

test('reconstruction puts standard sections before custom sections', () => {
  assert.strictEqual(journal.reconstructJournal({
    Custom: 'custom\n',
    Inbox: 'inbox\n',
    Notes: 'notes\n',
    __header__: 'header\n',
    Handoff: 'handoff\n',
  }), 'header\nhandoff\nnotes\ninbox\ncustom\n');
  assert.strictEqual(journal.reconstructJournal({}), '');
});

test('merge keeps unique sections and flags differing shared sections', () => {
  const local = { Notes: 'local note', Backlog: 'local task', Inbox: 'same' };
  const remote = { Notes: 'remote note', Handoff: 'remote handoff', Inbox: 'same' };
  const localBefore = { ...local };
  const remoteBefore = { ...remote };
  assert.deepStrictEqual(journal.mergeSections(local, remote), {
    merged: {
      Notes: 'local note', Backlog: 'local task', Inbox: 'same', Handoff: 'remote handoff',
    },
    conflicts: ['Notes'],
  });
  assert.deepStrictEqual(local, localBefore);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(remote, remoteBefore);
});

test('merge prefers local edits without conflict when the known remote hash matches', () => {
  const local = { Notes: 'local edit' };
  const remote = { Notes: 'previous note' };
  const knownHash = journal.computeContentHash(journal.reconstructJournal(remote));
  assert.deepStrictEqual(journal.mergeSections(local, remote, knownHash), {
    merged: { Notes: 'local edit' }, conflicts: [],
  });
  assert.deepStrictEqual(journal.mergeSections(local, remote, 'stale hash'), {
    merged: { Notes: 'local edit' }, conflicts: ['Notes'],
  });
});

function setEnv(key, value) {
  if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
  else process.env[key] = value;

function capture(fn) {
  const out = [];
  const err = [];
  const origLog = console.log;
  const origError = console.error;
  console.log = (...parts) => out.push(parts.join(' '));
  console.error = (...parts) => err.push(parts.join(' '));
  let code;
  try {
    code = fn();
  } finally {
    console.log = origLog;
    console.error = origError;
  }
  return { code, out: out.join('\n'), err: err.join('\n') };
}

function readLog() {
  if (!fs.existsSync(logFile)) return [];
  return fs.readFileSync(logFile, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean);
}

  for (const key of ENV_KEYS) setEnv(key, savedEnv[key]);
  fs.rmSync(tmpRoot, { recursive: true, force: true });

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');

const { logSyncAtris } = require('../commands/log-sync');

// commands/log-sync.js resolves everything from process.cwd() and reads
// process.argv[4] as the optional date argument. A temp dir plus an argv
// shim keeps the sync fully local: every test below stops before any
// network call (missing folder, bad date, or no agent configured).
function makeSandbox(t, { withAtrisDir = true, dateArg } = {}) {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'atris-log-sync-'));
  if (withAtrisDir) {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, 'atris'), { recursive: true });
  }

  const origCwd = process.cwd();
  const origLog = console.log;
  const origArgv4 = process.argv[4];

  const lines = [];

  process.chdir(root);
  console.log = (...args) => lines.push(args.join(' '));
  if (dateArg === undefined) {
    delete process.argv[4];
  } else {
    process.argv[4] = dateArg;
  }

  t.after(() => {
    console.log = origLog;
    process.chdir(origCwd);
    if (origArgv4 === undefined) {
      delete process.argv[4];
    } else {
      process.argv[4] = origArgv4;
    }
    fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });

  return { root, lines };
}

test('logSyncAtris throws when the atris/ folder is missing', async (t) => {
  makeSandbox(t, { withAtrisDir: false });

  await assert.rejects(
    () => logSyncAtris(),
    /atris\/ folder not found\. Run "atris init" first\./
  );
});

test('logSyncAtris rejects an unparseable --date argument', async (t) => {
  const { root } = makeSandbox(t, { dateArg: '--date=not-a-date' });

  await assert.rejects(
    () => logSyncAtris(),
    /Invalid date provided: not-a-date/
  );

  // The date check must run before any logs/ directory is created.
  assert.strictEqual(fs.existsSync(path.join(root, 'atris', 'logs')), false);
});

test('logSyncAtris creates the local log file, then fails without an agent', async (t) => {
  const { root, lines } = makeSandbox(t, { dateArg: '2020-01-15' });

  await assert.rejects(
    () => logSyncAtris(),
    /No agent selected\. Run "atris agent" first\./
  );

  // Before the credential check, the command scaffolds the daily log.
  const logFile = path.join(root, 'atris', 'logs', '2020', '2020-01-15.md');
  assert.strictEqual(fs.existsSync(logFile), true);
  assert.ok(fs.readFileSync(logFile, 'utf8').length > 0);
  assert.ok(lines.some((line) => line.includes('2020-01-15')));
});
'use strict';

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');

const { loopsCommand } = require('../commands/loops');

const TEMPLATE_ROOT = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'templates', 'loops');

// loopsCommand works on process.cwd() and the heartbeat registry, and only
// prints and returns an exit code. Run it in-process inside a temp project
// with HOME and the heartbeat dir pointed at temp folders, console captured.
function makeSandbox(t) {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'atris-loops-test-'));
  const project = path.join(root, 'project');
  const home = path.join(root, 'home');
  const heartbeat = path.join(root, 'heartbeat');
  for (const dir of [project, home, heartbeat]) fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });

  const saved = {
    cwd: process.cwd(),
    HOME: process.env.HOME,
    ATRIS_HEARTBEAT_DIR: process.env.ATRIS_HEARTBEAT_DIR,
  };
  process.env.HOME = home;
  process.env.ATRIS_HEARTBEAT_DIR = heartbeat;
  process.chdir(project);

  t.after(() => {
    process.chdir(saved.cwd);
    for (const key of ['HOME', 'ATRIS_HEARTBEAT_DIR']) {
      if (saved[key] === undefined) delete process.env[key];
      else process.env[key] = saved[key];
    }
    fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });

  // Realpath so comparisons survive /var -> /private/var on macOS.
  return { root, project: fs.realpathSync(project), heartbeat };
}

function run(t, ...args) {
  const out = [];
  const err = [];
  t.mock.method(console, 'log', (...parts) => out.push(parts.join(' ')));
  t.mock.method(console, 'error', (...parts) => err.push(parts.join(' ')));
  let exitCode = null;
  t.mock.method(process, 'exit', (code) => {
    exitCode = code;
    throw new Error(`process.exit(${code})`);
  });
  let code;
  try {
    code = loopsCommand(...args);
  } catch (error) {
    if (exitCode === null) throw error;
  }
  return { code, exitCode, out: out.join('\n'), err: err.join('\n') };
}

function localToday() {
  const d = new Date();
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function write(file, text) {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(file, text);
}

function snapshot(dir) {
  const found = [];
  (function walk(current) {
    for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(current, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      const full = path.join(current, entry.name);
      if (entry.isDirectory()) walk(full);
      else found.push(path.relative(dir, full));
    }
  })(dir);
  return found.sort();
}

test('help flags and unknown subcommands print usage and exit 0 without touching files', (t) => {
  const { project } = makeSandbox(t);
  const cases = [
    ['--help'],
    ['-h'],
    ['help'],
    ['nonsense'],
    ['init', '--help'],
    ['tick', '-h'],
    ['stop', '--help'],
  ];
  for (const args of cases) {
    const result = run(t, ...args);
    assert.strictEqual(result.code, 0, `exit code for ${args.join(' ')}`);
    assert.match(result.out, /^Usage: atris loops \[audit\|init\|tick\|board\|start\|stop\]/, args.join(' '));
    assert.match(result.out, /atris loops init\s+- scaffold atris\/loops \+ loop wiki/);
    assert.match(result.out, /atris loops stop <id>\s+- disable a registry job or stop a launchd agent/);
    t.mock.restoreAll();
  }
  assert.deepStrictEqual(snapshot(project), [], 'help must not create any project files');
});

test('audit with no atris/loops folder says how to start and exits 1', (t) => {
  makeSandbox(t);
  const bare = run(t);
  assert.strictEqual(bare.code, 1);
  assert.match(bare.out, /^No atris\/loops directory found\./);
  assert.match(bare.out, /Run: atris loops init/);
  assert.match(bare.out, /SELF-IMPROVING: NOT YET, 1 open$/);
  t.mock.restoreAll();

  // An existing folder holding only the protocol files has no loops to audit.
  const project = process.cwd();
  write(path.join(project, 'atris', 'loops', 'LOOPS.md'), '# loops\n');
  write(path.join(project, 'atris', 'loops', 'TICK.md'), '# tick\n');
  const empty = run(t, 'audit');
  assert.strictEqual(empty.code, 1);
  assert.match(empty.out, /^No loop files found in atris\/loops\./);
  assert.match(empty.out, /SELF-IMPROVING: NOT YET, 1 open$/);
});

test('init scaffolds every file once, fills in the date, and skips existing files on a rerun', (t) => {
  const { project } = makeSandbox(t);
  const expected = [
    'atris/loops/LOOPS.md',
    'atris/loops/TICK.md',
    'atris/loops/feedback.md',
    'atris/loops/quality.md',
    'atris/wiki/systems/loops.md',
  ];

  const first = run(t, 'init');
  assert.strictEqual(first.code, 0);
  assert.match(first.out, /^atris loops init/);
  const createdBlock = first.out.split('created:\n')[1].split('\n\nskipped:')[0];
  assert.deepStrictEqual(createdBlock.split('\n').map((line) => line.trim()), expected);
  assert.match(first.out, /skipped:\n {2}none/);
  assert.match(first.out, /Next: fill Owner\/Wiki\/Runner TODOs, then run atris loops audit$/);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(snapshot(project), [...expected].sort());

  for (const rel of expected) {
    const text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(project, rel), 'utf8');
    assert.ok(!text.includes('{{DATE}}'), `${rel} still has a raw date placeholder`);
  }
  const template = fs.readFileSync(path.join(TEMPLATE_ROOT, 'atris/loops/quality.md'), 'utf8');
  assert.ok(template.includes('{{DATE}}'), 'quality template is expected to carry the placeholder');
  const rendered = fs.readFileSync(path.join(project, 'atris/loops/quality.md'), 'utf8');
  assert.strictEqual(rendered, template.split('{{DATE}}').join(localToday()));
  t.mock.restoreAll();

  // Edit one file, rerun: nothing is overwritten and everything is skipped.
  const edited = path.join(project, 'atris/loops/LOOPS.md');
  fs.writeFileSync(edited, 'my own notes\n');
  const second = run(t, 'init');
  assert.strictEqual(second.code, 0);
  assert.match(second.out, /created:\n {2}none/);
  const skippedBlock = second.out.split('skipped:\n')[1].split('\n\nNext:')[0];
  assert.deepStrictEqual(skippedBlock.split('\n').map((line) => line.trim()), expected);
  assert.strictEqual(fs.readFileSync(edited, 'utf8'), 'my own notes\n');
});

test('audit passes a complete loop and reports each problem on a broken one', (t) => {
  const { project } = makeSandbox(t);
  const today = localToday();

  write(path.join(project, 'atris', 'team', 'builder', 'MEMBER.md'), '# builder\n');
  write(path.join(project, 'atris', 'wiki', 'systems', 'good.md'), '# good\n');
  write(path.join(project, 'atris', 'loops', 'good.md'), [
    '# good loop',
    '',
    '**Owner:** `team/builder`',
    '**Wiki:** [good](../wiki/systems/good.md#how)',
    '**Runner:** `atris tick`',
    '**Protects:** the build stays green',
    '**Signal:** failing builds per week',
    '**Cadence:** daily',
    '**Check:** `exit 0`',
    '',
    '## Log',
    `- ${today}: ran clean`,
    '',
  ].join('\n'));

  const healthy = run(t, 'audit');
  assert.strictEqual(healthy.code, 0);
  assert.match(healthy.out, /^atris loops audit/);
  assert.match(healthy.out, /✅ good\n/);
  assert.match(healthy.out, /↳ check: `exit 0` exit 0/);
  assert.match(healthy.out, /SELF-IMPROVING: YES$/);
  t.mock.restoreAll();

  write(path.join(project, 'atris', 'loops', 'bad.md'), '# bad loop\n\nnothing filled in\n');
  write(path.join(project, 'atris', 'loops', 'ghost.md'), [
    '**Owner:** `team/nobody`',
    '**Wiki:** [gone](../wiki/systems/gone.md)',
    '**Runner:** `atris tick`',
    '**Protects:** x',
    '**Signal:** y',
    '**Cadence:** daily',
    '**Check:** `exit 3`',
    '- 2020-01-01: ancient entry',
    '',
  ].join('\n'));

  const broken = run(t, 'audit');
  assert.strictEqual(broken.code, 1);
  assert.match(broken.out, /✅ good\n/);
  assert.match(broken.out, /❌ bad\n/);
  for (const problem of [
    'no Owner field',
    'no Wiki field',
    'no Runner field',
    'no Protects field',
    'no Signal field',
    'no Cadence field',
    'no dated Log entries',
  ]) {
    assert.ok(broken.out.includes(`   ↳ ${problem}`), `bad loop should report: ${problem}`);
  }
  assert.match(broken.out, /❌ ghost\n/);
  assert.ok(broken.out.includes('   ↳ owner team/nobody does not exist'));
  assert.ok(broken.out.includes('   ↳ wiki page ../wiki/systems/gone.md missing'));
  assert.ok(broken.out.includes('   ↳ log stale: newest 2020-01-01'));
  assert.ok(broken.out.includes('   ↳ check failed: exit 3'));
  assert.match(broken.out, /SELF-IMPROVING: NOT YET, 2 open$/);
});

test('stop and start flip a registry job, write a backup, and reject bad ids', (t) => {
  const { heartbeat } = makeSandbox(t);
  const registryFile = path.join(heartbeat, 'registry.json');
  const original = {
    jobs: [
      { id: 'night-sweep', cadence_minutes: 120, purpose: 'sweep', enabled: true },
      { id: 'other-job', cadence_minutes: 15, purpose: 'other' },
    ],
  };
  fs.writeFileSync(registryFile, `${JSON.stringify(original, null, 2)}\n`);

  const stopped = run(t, 'stop', 'night-sweep');
  assert.strictEqual(stopped.code, 0);
  assert.strictEqual(stopped.out, 'Disabled night-sweep in the heartbeat registry (backup written).');
  const afterStop = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(registryFile, 'utf8'));
  const sweep = afterStop.jobs.find((job) => job.id === 'night-sweep');
  assert.strictEqual(sweep.enabled, false);
  assert.strictEqual(sweep.disabled, true);
  assert.strictEqual(sweep.disabled_reason, `stopped via atris loops ${localToday()}`);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(afterStop.jobs.find((job) => job.id === 'other-job'), original.jobs[1]);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${registryFile}.bak`, 'utf8')), original);
  t.mock.restoreAll();

  const started = run(t, 'start', 'night-sweep');
  assert.strictEqual(started.code, 0);
  assert.strictEqual(started.out, 'Enabled night-sweep in the heartbeat registry (backup written).');
  const revived = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(registryFile, 'utf8')).jobs.find((job) => job.id === 'night-sweep');
  assert.strictEqual(revived.enabled, true);
  assert.ok(!('disabled' in revived));
  assert.ok(!('disabled_reason' in revived));
  t.mock.restoreAll();

  const unknown = run(t, 'stop', 'no-such-job');
  assert.strictEqual(unknown.exitCode, 1);
  assert.strictEqual(unknown.err, 'No registry job named "no-such-job". Run: atris loops board');
  t.mock.restoreAll();

  const missing = run(t, 'start');
  assert.strictEqual(missing.exitCode, 1);
  assert.strictEqual(missing.err, 'Usage: atris loops start <id>');
});
'use strict';

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { meetCommand, slugify } = require('../commands/meet');

function tmp(t, prefix = 'meet-') {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), prefix));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  return dir;
}

// Pre-create the two sentinels meet.js checks so the test stays local:
// atris/ skips initAtris scaffolding, .atris/theme.json skips `theme init`.
function preparedWorkspace(t) {
  const dir = tmp(t);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'atris'), { recursive: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, '.atris'), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, '.atris', 'theme.json'), '{}');
  return dir;
}

async function captureRun(fn) {
  const out = [];
  const err = [];
  const origLog = console.log;
  const origErr = console.error;
  console.log = (...a) => out.push(a.join(' '));
  console.error = (...a) => err.push(a.join(' '));
  try {
    const code = await fn();
    return { code, out, err };
  } finally {
    console.log = origLog;
    console.error = origErr;
  }
}

function withEnv(vars, fn) {
  const saved = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(vars)) {
    saved[key] = process.env[key];
    process.env[key] = vars[key];
  }
  return Promise.resolve()
    .then(fn)
    .finally(() => {
      for (const key of Object.keys(vars)) {
        if (saved[key] === undefined) delete process.env[key];
        else process.env[key] = saved[key];
      }
    });
}

test('slugify turns a name into a booking-handle-safe slug', () => {
  assert.equal(slugify('Ada Lovelace'), 'ada-lovelace');
  assert.equal(slugify('  Madé  O\'Brien!! '), 'mad-o-brien');
  assert.equal(slugify(''), 'guest');
  assert.equal(slugify('!!!'), 'guest');
  assert.equal(slugify('x'.repeat(80)).length, 48);
});

  assert.ok(out.some((line) => line.includes('--name')));

});

test('meet without the required flags refuses non-interactively with code 2', async (t) => {
  const dir = tmp(t);
  const prevIsTTY = process.stdin.isTTY;
  process.stdin.isTTY = false;
  try {
    const { code, err } = await captureRun(() => meetCommand(['--name', 'Ada'], dir));
    assert.equal(code, 2);
    assert.ok(err.some((line) => line.includes('meet needs') && line.includes('--want') && line.includes('--currency')));
  } finally {
    process.stdin.isTTY = prevIsTTY;
  }

function withWorkspace(t, run) {

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { proofCommand } = require('../commands/proof');

function withTempEnv(fn) {
  const tempDir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'atris-proof-test-'));
  const originalHome = process.env.HOME;
  const originalCwd = process.cwd();
  const originalExitCode = process.exitCode;
  process.env.HOME = tempDir;
  try {
    process.chdir(tempDir);
    return fn(tempDir);
  } finally {
    process.chdir(originalCwd);
    process.env.HOME = originalHome;
    process.exitCode = originalExitCode;
    fs.rmSync(tempDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

function captureOutput(fn) {
  const originalLog = console.log;
  const originalError = console.error;
  const logs = [];
  const errors = [];
  console.log = (...args) => logs.push(args.join(' '));
  console.error = (...args) => errors.push(args.join(' '));
  try {
    fn();
    return { logs, errors };
  } finally {
    console.log = originalLog;
    console.error = originalError;
  }
}

test('proofCommand displays usage for help and handles unknown subcommands', () => {
  withTempEnv(() => {
    const helpOut = captureOutput(() => {
      proofCommand('help');
    });
    assert.strictEqual(
      helpOut.logs.some((line) => line.includes('Usage: atris receipt [doctor|init <slug>|run --dry-run]')),
      true
    );

    const unknownOut = captureOutput(() => {
      proofCommand('unknown-action');
    });
    assert.strictEqual(
      unknownOut.errors.some((line) => line.includes('Unknown receipt command: unknown-action')),
      true
    );
    assert.strictEqual(process.exitCode, 1);
  });
});

        slug: 'test-hub',

      'utf8'

      true
    );

      'atris computer proof',

    ]);

    const docReady = captureOutput(() => {
      proofCommand('doctor');

      true
    );
    assert.strictEqual(
      docReady.logs.some((line) => line.includes('receipt folder: ready')),
      true
    );
  });
});

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');

// The publish network call is the only thing stubbed. commands/publish picks up
// apiRequestJson when it loads, so the stub goes on the export before the
// require below.
const api = require('../utils/api');
const apiCalls = [];
let apiReply = { ok: true, status: 200, data: {} };
api.apiRequestJson = async (route, opts) => {
  apiCalls.push({ route, opts });
  return apiReply;
};

const { publishAtris } = require('../commands/publish');

class ExitSignal extends Error {
  constructor(code) {
    super(`process.exit(${code})`);
    this.code = code;
  }
}

const CRED_ENV_KEYS = ['ATRIS_TOKEN', 'ATRIS_PROFILE', 'ATRIS_AGENT_TOKEN_FILE'];

function setup(t) {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'atris-publish-cmd-test-'));
  const home = path.join(root, 'home');
  const workspace = path.join(root, 'my-studio');
  fs.mkdirSync(home);
  fs.mkdirSync(workspace);

  const originalCwd = process.cwd();
  const originalHome = process.env.HOME;
  const originalArgv = process.argv;
  const savedEnv = {};
  for (const key of CRED_ENV_KEYS) {
    savedEnv[key] = process.env[key];
    delete process.env[key];
  }

  process.env.HOME = home;
  process.chdir(workspace);
  apiCalls.length = 0;
  apiReply = { ok: true, status: 200, data: {} };

  t.after(() => {
    process.chdir(originalCwd);
    process.argv = originalArgv;
    if (originalHome === undefined) delete process.env.HOME;
    else process.env.HOME = originalHome;
    for (const key of CRED_ENV_KEYS) {
      if (savedEnv[key] === undefined) delete process.env[key];
      else process.env[key] = savedEnv[key];
    }
    fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });

  return { home, workspace };
}

function writeCredentials(home) {
  const dir = path.join(home, '.atris');
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'credentials.json'), JSON.stringify({ token: 'test-token' }));
}

function writeFile(root, rel, content) {
  const full = path.join(root, rel);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(full), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(full, content);
}

async function runPublish(args) {
  const out = [];
  const err = [];
  const originalArgv = process.argv;
  const originalLog = console.log;
  const originalError = console.error;
  const originalExit = process.exit;
  let exitCode;

  process.argv = ['node', 'atris', 'publish', ...args];
  console.log = (...parts) => out.push(parts.join(' '));
  console.error = (...parts) => err.push(parts.join(' '));
  process.exit = (code) => {
    throw new ExitSignal(code);
  };

  try {
    await publishAtris();
  } catch (e) {
    if (!(e instanceof ExitSignal)) throw e;
    exitCode = e.code;
  } finally {
    process.argv = originalArgv;
    console.log = originalLog;
    console.error = originalError;
    process.exit = originalExit;
  }

  return { code: exitCode, stdout: out.join('\n'), stderr: err.join('\n') };
}

  for (const flag of ['--help', '-h', 'help']) {
    const result = await runPublish([flag]);
    assert.strictEqual(result.code, 0, `exit code for ${flag}`);
    assert.strictEqual(result.stderr, '');
    assert.strictEqual(result.stdout, [

});

'use strict';

const { test } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process');
const { releaseAtris, releasePreflight } = require('../commands/release');

function git(cwd, ...args) {
  return execFileSync('git', args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }).trim();
}

// Throwaway repo: one seed commit at version 1.2.3, tagged v1.2.3 unless tag is false.
// Each subject in `after` becomes an empty commit on top of the seed.
function makeRepo(t, { tag = true, after = [], pkg = true } = {}) {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'atris-release-command-'));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }));

  git(dir, 'init', '--initial-branch=master');
  git(dir, 'config', 'user.email', 'release-command@test.invalid');
  git(dir, 'config', 'user.name', 'release command test');
  git(dir, 'config', 'commit.gpgsign', 'false');

  if (pkg) {
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'package.json'), `${JSON.stringify({ name: 'release-command-fixture', version: '1.2.3' }, null, 2)}\n`);
  } else {
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'README.md'), '# fixture\n');
  }
  git(dir, 'add', '.');
  git(dir, 'commit', '-m', 'seed');
  if (tag) git(dir, 'tag', 'v1.2.3');
  for (const subject of after) git(dir, 'commit', '--allow-empty', '-m', subject);
  return dir;
}

// Makes origin/master point at HEAD. Preflight only compares refs, so no real remote is needed.
function publishOrigin(dir, ref = 'HEAD') {
  git(dir, 'update-ref', 'refs/remotes/origin/master', ref);
}

// Runs fn with console.log captured. Returns the printed lines and fn's result.
// Multi-line messages (the changelog) are split so each commit is its own line.
async function capture(fn) {
  const lines = [];
  const log = console.log;
  console.log = (...args) => lines.push(...args.join(' ').split('\n'));
  try {
    const result = await fn();
    return { lines, result };
  } finally {
    console.log = log;
  }
}

// releaseAtris reads process.cwd(), so move into the repo for the call and restore after.
async function inDir(dir, fn) {
  const original = process.cwd();
  process.chdir(dir);
  try {
    return await fn();
  } finally {
    process.chdir(original);
  }
}

test('dry-run plans a patch bump from the commits since the last tag and changes nothing', async (t) => {
  const dir = makeRepo(t, { after: ['fix the parser', 'add the status line'] });

  const { lines } = await capture(() => inDir(dir, () => releaseAtris({ dryRun: true })));

  assert.ok(lines.includes('commits since v1.2.3: 2'));
  assert.ok(lines.includes('bump type: patch'));
  assert.ok(lines.includes('version: 1.2.3 → 1.2.4'));
  assert.ok(lines.some(l => /^- [a-f0-9]+ fix the parser$/.test(l)));
  assert.ok(lines.some(l => /^- [a-f0-9]+ add the status line$/.test(l)));
  assert.ok(lines.includes('tag: v1.2.4'));
  assert.ok(lines.includes('Atris v1.2.4 is out.'));
  // git log is newest first, so the launch post leads with the latest commit.
  assert.ok(lines.includes('🚀 add the status line'));
  assert.ok(lines.includes('⚡ fix the parser'));

  assert.equal(git(dir, 'tag', '--list'), 'v1.2.3');
  assert.equal(git(dir, 'rev-list', '--count', 'HEAD'), '3');
  assert.equal(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'package.json'), 'utf8')).version, '1.2.3');
});

test('a scorecard reward of 5 plans a minor bump, and 4 stays a patch', async (t) => {
  const dir = makeRepo(t, { after: ['ship the thing'] });
  const scorecards = path.join(dir, 'atris', 'scorecards');
  fs.mkdirSync(scorecards, { recursive: true });
  const card = path.join(scorecards, 'alpha.md');

  fs.writeFileSync(card, '# alpha\n\nreward: 4\n');
  const low = await capture(() => inDir(dir, () => releaseAtris({ dryRun: true })));
  assert.ok(low.lines.includes('bump type: patch'));
  assert.ok(low.lines.includes('version: 1.2.3 → 1.2.4'));

  fs.writeFileSync(card, '# alpha\n\nreward: 5\n');
  const high = await capture(() => inDir(dir, () => releaseAtris({ dryRun: true })));
  assert.ok(high.lines.includes('bump type: minor'));
  assert.ok(high.lines.includes('version: 1.2.3 → 1.3.0'));
});

test('preflight reports a failing suite by its exit code, and a suite that cannot start by its error', async (t) => {

  const missing = await capture(() => releasePreflight({

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process');

const { reviewCommand } = require('../commands/review');

// review.js never reads HOME, but it searches process.cwd() and a few parents
// for the engine script, so every run happens inside a scratch workspace.
const sandbox = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'atris-review-command-'));
const realCwd = process.cwd();

const probe = spawnSync('python3', ['--version'], { encoding: 'utf8' });
const hasPython = probe.status === 0;

let workspaceCount = 0;

function makeWorkspace({ engine = null, services = null } = {}) {
  workspaceCount += 1;
  const root = path.join(sandbox, `ws-${workspaceCount}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(root, { recursive: true });
  if (engine !== null) fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'review_engine.py'), engine);
  if (services !== null) {
    const dir = path.join(root, 'backend', 'services');
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    for (const [name, body] of Object.entries(services)) {
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, name), body);
    }
  }
  return root;
}

class ExitSignal extends Error {
  constructor(code) {
    super(`process.exit(${code})`);
    this.code = code;
  }
}

// Runs the command inside `cwd` with console and process.exit captured.
async function run(cwd, args) {
  const logs = [];
  const errors = [];
  const original = {
    log: console.log,
    error: console.error,
    exit: process.exit,
  };
  let exitCode = null;
  console.log = (...parts) => { logs.push(parts.join(' ')); };
  console.error = (...parts) => { errors.push(parts.join(' ')); };
  process.exit = (code) => { throw new ExitSignal(code); };
  process.chdir(cwd);
  try {
    await reviewCommand(...args);
  } catch (err) {
    if (!(err instanceof ExitSignal)) throw err;
    exitCode = err.code;
  } finally {
    process.chdir(realCwd);
    console.log = original.log;
    console.error = original.error;
    process.exit = original.exit;
  }
  return { logs, errors, exitCode };
}

// Fake engine that records the arguments it was called with, then exits.
function argvRecorder(exitCode = 0) {
  return [
    'import json, os, sys',
    "with open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), 'argv.json'), 'w') as f:",
    '    json.dump(sys.argv[1:], f)',
    `sys.exit(${exitCode})`,
    '',
  ].join('\n');
}

// Fake engine that answers per file name, like the real one answers per file.
const AUDIT_ENGINE = [
  'import json, os, sys',
  'args = sys.argv[1:]',
  "name = os.path.basename(args[args.index('--file') + 1])",
  'answers = {',
  "    'bad.py': {'quality_score': 3, 'findings': [",
  "        {'severity': 'high', 'rule': 'sql-injection'},",
  "        {'severity': 'medium', 'rule': 'weak-hash'},",
  "        {'severity': 'low', 'rule': 'naming'}]},",
  "    'meh.py': {'quality_score': 6, 'findings': [{'severity': 'medium', 'rule': 'bare-except'}]},",
  "    'clean.py': {'quality_score': 10, 'findings': [{'severity': 'low', 'rule': 'naming'}]},",
  '}',
  "if name == 'broken.py':",
  "    print('this is not json')",
  'else:',
  '    print(json.dumps(answers[name]))',
  '',
].join('\n');

const AUDIT_SERVICES = {
  'bad.py': '',
  'meh.py': '',
  'clean.py': '',
  'broken.py': '',
  'notes.txt': 'not a service',
};

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { securityReviewCommand } = require('../commands/security-review');

function capture(fn) {
  const logs = [];
  const errs = [];
  const origLog = console.log;
  const origErr = console.error;
  console.log = (...args) => { logs.push(args.map(String).join(' ')); };
  console.error = (...args) => { errs.push(args.map(String).join(' ')); };
  try {
    const code = fn();
    return { code, stdout: logs.join('\n'), stderr: errs.join('\n') };
  } finally {
    console.log = origLog;
    console.error = origErr;
  }
}

function withTempHome(fn) {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'atris-sec-review-cmd-'));
  const prevHome = process.env.HOME;
  const prevCwd = process.cwd();
  process.env.HOME = dir;
  process.chdir(dir);
  try {
    return fn(dir);
  } finally {
    process.chdir(prevCwd);
    if (prevHome === undefined) delete process.env.HOME;
    else process.env.HOME = prevHome;
    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

test('help and rules print the real command text and return 0', () => {
  const help = capture(() => securityReviewCommand(['--help']));
  assert.strictEqual(help.code, 0);
  assert.match(help.stdout, /atris security-review, deterministic secrets/);
  assert.match(help.stdout, /security-review --json/);
  assert.match(help.stdout, /exit 0 = clean, 1 = found/);

  const shortHelp = capture(() => securityReviewCommand(['-h']));
  assert.strictEqual(shortHelp.code, 0);
  assert.match(shortHelp.stdout, /security-review hook/);

  const namedHelp = capture(() => securityReviewCommand(['help']));
  assert.strictEqual(namedHelp.code, 0);
  assert.match(namedHelp.stdout, /--no-baseline/);

  const rules = capture(() => securityReviewCommand(['rules']));
  assert.strictEqual(rules.code, 0);
  assert.match(rules.stdout, /deterministic rules/);
  assert.match(rules.stdout, /CRITICAL\s+secret\s+github-token/);
  assert.match(rules.stdout, /atris-allow-secret/);
});

test('bad flags exit 2 and name the usage error', () => {
  const unknown = capture(() => securityReviewCommand(['--nope']));
  assert.strictEqual(unknown.code, 2);
  assert.match(unknown.stderr, /security-review: unknown flag: --nope/);

  const missing = capture(() => securityReviewCommand(['--baseline']));
  assert.strictEqual(missing.code, 2);
  assert.match(missing.stderr, /security-review: --baseline requires a path/);

  const clash = capture(() => securityReviewCommand(['--update-baseline', '--no-baseline']));
  assert.strictEqual(clash.code, 2);
  assert.match(clash.stderr, /security-review: --update-baseline cannot be combined with --no-baseline/);
});

test('json scan fails on a real key and passes when that file is clean', () => {
  withTempHome((dir) => {
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'leak.js'), 'const k = "AKIA4F7D9Q2L8W6R3P5S";\n');
    const bad = capture(() => securityReviewCommand(['.', '--json', '--no-record']));
    assert.strictEqual(bad.code, 1, bad.stderr);
    const report = JSON.parse(bad.stdout);
    assert.strictEqual(report.ok, false);
    assert.strictEqual(report.generated_for, 'soc2-evidence');
    assert.strictEqual(report.fail_threshold, 'high');
    assert.strictEqual(report.scanned, 1);
    assert.ok(report.score >= 100);
    const hit = report.findings.find((f) => f.rule === 'aws-access-key-id');
    assert.ok(hit);
    assert.strictEqual(hit.sev, 'critical');
    assert.strictEqual(hit.file, 'leak.js');
    assert.strictEqual(hit.line, 1);

    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'leak.js'), 'module.exports = 42;\n');
    const good = capture(() => securityReviewCommand(['.', '--json', '--no-record']));
    assert.strictEqual(good.code, 0, good.stderr);
    const clean = JSON.parse(good.stdout);
    assert.strictEqual(clean.ok, true);
    assert.deepStrictEqual(clean.findings, []);
    assert.strictEqual(clean.scanned, 1);
    assert.strictEqual(clean.score, 0);
  });
});

test('hook writes a pre-commit gate inside the temp dir and does not install twice', () => {
  withTempHome((dir) => {
    const installed = capture(() => securityReviewCommand(['hook']));
    assert.strictEqual(installed.code, 0);
    assert.match(installed.stdout, /security pre-commit gate installed/);
    const hookPath = path.join(dir, '.git', 'hooks', 'pre-commit');
    const hook = fs.readFileSync(hookPath, 'utf8');
    assert.match(hook, /# atris security gate/);
    assert.match(hook, /atris security-review --staged --quiet \|\| exit 1/);
    assert.strictEqual(fs.statSync(hookPath).mode & 0o111, 0o111);

    const again = capture(() => securityReviewCommand(['hook']));
    assert.strictEqual(again.code, 0);
    assert.match(again.stdout, /already installed/);
  });
});
'use strict';

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');

// Keep any credential/profile reads inside a temp home.
const tmpHome = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'atris-setup-test-'));
process.env.HOME = tmpHome;

// commands/setup.js hits the network (utils/api), prompts and reads credentials
// (utils/auth), and lazily requires ./auth and ./pull for the login and pull
// flows. It destructures those functions at require time, so the fakes below
// delegate to a mutable `impl` object that each test can re-point safely.
const impl = {
  loadCredentials: () => null,
  promptUser: async () => '',
  apiRequestJson: async () => ({ ok: true, data: [] }),
  loginAtris: async () => {},
  pullAtris: async () => {},
};

const fakeAuth = {
  loadCredentials: (...args) => impl.loadCredentials(...args),
  promptUser: (...args) => impl.promptUser(...args),
};
const fakeApi = { apiRequestJson: (...args) => impl.apiRequestJson(...args) };
const fakeLogin = { loginAtris: (...args) => impl.loginAtris(...args) };
const fakePull = { pullAtris: (...args) => impl.pullAtris(...args) };

for (const [modPath, exportsObj] of [
  [require.resolve('../utils/auth'), fakeAuth],
  [require.resolve('../utils/api'), fakeApi],
  [require.resolve('../commands/auth'), fakeLogin],
  [require.resolve('../commands/pull'), fakePull],
]) {
  require.cache[modPath] = { id: modPath, filename: modPath, loaded: true, exports: exportsObj };
}

const { setupAtris } = require('../commands/setup');

function capture() {
  const lines = [];
  const realLog = console.log;
  const realErr = console.error;
  console.log = (...args) => lines.push(args.join(' '));
  console.error = (...args) => lines.push(args.join(' '));
  return {
    text: () => lines.join('\n'),
    restore() {
      console.log = realLog;
      console.error = realErr;
    },
  };
}

test('logged-in user sees the fetch error and the finish banner when the API fails', async () => {
  const calls = [];
  impl.loadCredentials = () => ({ token: 'tok-1', email: 'dev@example.com' });
  impl.apiRequestJson = async (pathname, options) => {
    calls.push({ pathname, options });
    return { ok: false, status: 500, error: 'server exploded' };
  };

  const cap = capture();
  try {
    await setupAtris();
  } finally {
    cap.restore();
  }
  const out = cap.text();

  assert.deepEqual(calls.map((c) => c.pathname), ['/business/']);
  assert.equal(calls[0].options.token, 'tok-1');
  assert.match(out, /Logged in as dev@example\.com/);
  assert.match(out, /Could not fetch businesses: server exploded/);
  assert.match(out, /atris business add <slug>/);
  assert.match(out, /You're all set! Run `atris activate` to start\./);
});

  const pulled = [];

test('no saved login runs login, reloads credentials, then lists zero businesses', async () => {
  let credCalls = 0;
  let loginCalls = 0;
  impl.loadCredentials = () => {
    credCalls += 1;
    return credCalls === 1 ? null : { token: 'tok-4', email: 'new@example.com' };
  };
  impl.loginAtris = async () => {
    loginCalls += 1;
    process.exit(0);
  };
  impl.apiRequestJson = async () => ({ ok: true, status: 200, data: [] });

  const cap = capture();
  try {
    await setupAtris();
  } finally {
    cap.restore();
  }
  const out = cap.text();

  assert.equal(loginCalls, 1);
  assert.ok(credCalls >= 2, 'credentials reloaded after login');
  assert.match(out, /Not logged in\. Starting login/);
  assert.match(out, /\[2\/4\] Logged in \.\.\. OK/);
  assert.match(out, /No businesses found on your account\./);
  assert.match(out, /You're all set!/);
});

test('an expired login exits after the 401 from the business list', async () => {
  impl.loadCredentials = () => ({ token: 'expired-tok', email: 'dev@example.com' });
  impl.apiRequestJson = async () => ({ ok: false, status: 401, error: 'unauthorized' });

  const cap = capture();
  const exits = [];
  const realExit = process.exit;
  process.exit = (code) => { exits.push(code); };
  try {
    await setupAtris();
  } finally {
    process.exit = realExit;
    cap.restore();
  }
  const out = cap.text();

  assert.ok(exits.includes(1));
  assert.match(out, /saved login has expired/);
  assert.match(out, /Run "atris login", then "atris setup" again\./);
});
'use strict';

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');

const {
  TRAILER,
  installSignHook,
  removeSignHook,
  signCommand,
  signStatus,
} = require('../commands/sign');

function tempRepo(t) {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'atris-sign-'));
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, '.git'));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  return root;
}

function withCwd(root, fn) {
  const previous = process.cwd();
  process.chdir(root);
  try {
    return fn();
  } finally {
    process.chdir(previous);
  }
}

function captureLog(fn) {
  const lines = [];
  const original = console.log;
  console.log = (...args) => lines.push(args.map((part) => String(part)).join(' '));
  try {
    const code = fn();
    return { code, out: lines.join('\n') };
  } finally {
    console.log = original;
  }
}

test('install writes one executable co-author hook and status reports it', (t) => {
  const bare = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'atris-sign-nogit-'));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(bare, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  assert.throws(() => installSignHook(bare), /not a git repo/);

  const root = tempRepo(t);
  const hookPath = path.join(root, '.git', 'hooks', 'prepare-commit-msg');
  const first = installSignHook(root);
  const text = fs.readFileSync(hookPath, 'utf8');

  assert.strictEqual(first.already, false);
  assert.strictEqual(first.hookPath, hookPath);
  assert.ok(text.startsWith('#!/bin/sh\n'));
  assert.ok(text.includes('# atris co-author'));
  assert.ok(text.includes('"$2" != "merge"'));
  assert.ok(text.includes('"$2" != "squash"'));
  assert.ok(text.includes(TRAILER));
  assert.strictEqual(fs.statSync(hookPath).mode & 0o777, 0o755);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(signStatus(root), { hookPath, installed: true });

  const second = installSignHook(root);
  assert.strictEqual(second.already, true);
  assert.strictEqual(fs.readFileSync(hookPath, 'utf8'), text);
});

test('remove leaves other hook lines, and sign reports help, status, and off', (t) => {
  const root = tempRepo(t);
  const hookPath = path.join(root, '.git', 'hooks', 'prepare-commit-msg');
  const foreign = '#!/bin/sh\necho keep-me\n';

  assert.deepStrictEqual(removeSignHook(root), { hookPath, removed: false });
  assert.deepStrictEqual(signStatus(root), { hookPath, installed: false });

  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(hookPath), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(hookPath, foreign);
  installSignHook(root);
  assert.strictEqual(removeSignHook(root).removed, true);
  assert.strictEqual(fs.readFileSync(hookPath, 'utf8'), foreign);

  fs.rmSync(hookPath);
  installSignHook(root);
  assert.strictEqual(removeSignHook(root).removed, true);
  assert.strictEqual(fs.existsSync(hookPath), false);

  withCwd(root, () => {
    const help = captureLog(() => signCommand('nope'));
    assert.strictEqual(help.code, 2);
    assert.ok(help.out.includes('atris sign          install the prepare-commit-msg hook'));
    assert.ok(help.out.includes('atris sign off      remove it'));
    assert.ok(help.out.includes('atris sign status   check whether it\'s installed'));
    assert.ok(help.out.includes(TRAILER));

    const off = captureLog(() => signCommand('status'));
    assert.strictEqual(off.code, 0);
    assert.ok(off.out.includes("atris co-author is off, run 'atris sign' to turn it on"));

    const installed = captureLog(() => signCommand());
    assert.strictEqual(installed.code, 0);
    assert.ok(installed.out.includes('atris co-author installed: .git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg'));
    assert.ok(installed.out.includes(TRAILER));
    assert.strictEqual(signStatus(root).installed, true);

    const again = captureLog(() => signCommand('install'));
    assert.strictEqual(again.code, 0);
    assert.ok(again.out.includes('already installed: .git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg'));

    const on = captureLog(() => signCommand('on'));
    assert.strictEqual(on.code, 0);
    assert.ok(on.out.includes('already installed: .git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg'));

    const status = captureLog(() => signCommand('status'));
    assert.strictEqual(status.code, 0);
    assert.ok(status.out.includes('atris co-author is on: .git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg'));
    assert.ok(status.out.includes(`every commit gets: ${TRAILER}`));

    const removed = captureLog(() => signCommand('off'));
    assert.strictEqual(removed.code, 0);
    assert.ok(removed.out.includes('atris co-author removed: .git/hooks/prepare-commit-msg'));
    assert.strictEqual(fs.existsSync(hookPath), false);

    const nothing = captureLog(() => signCommand('remove'));
    assert.strictEqual(nothing.code, 0);
    assert.ok(nothing.out.includes('nothing to remove, atris co-author is not installed'));
  });
});

  console.error = (...a) => lines.push(a.join(' '));
  try {
    return { code: await fn(), out: lines.join('\n') };
  } finally {
    console.log = origLog;
    console.error = origErr;
  }
}

const test = require('node:test');

// These synchronous tests change process-wide state and must run serially.
function workspace(t) {
  const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'status-command-'));
  const cwd = process.cwd();
  const keys = ['HOME', 'ATRIS_TASKS_DB', 'ATRIS_TASK_DB'];
  const saved = Object.fromEntries(keys.map(key => [key, process.env[key]]));
  t.after(() => {
    process.chdir(cwd);
    for (const key of keys) {
      if (saved[key] === undefined) delete process.env[key];
      else process.env[key] = saved[key];
    }
    fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });
  process.env.HOME = root;
  process.env.ATRIS_TASKS_DB = path.join(root, 'tasks.db');
  process.env.ATRIS_TASK_DB = '0';
  process.chdir(root);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(root, 'atris'));
  return root;
}

function capture(t) {
  const lines = [];
  const original = console.log;
  console.log = (...args) => lines.push(args.join(' '));
  t.after(() => { console.log = original; });
  return lines;
}

test('JSON status reads journal backlog, inbox, recent completions and lessons', { concurrency: false }, t => {
  const root = workspace(t);
  const { statusAtris } = require('../commands/status');
  const { getLogPath } = require('../lib/journal');
  const { logFile, dateFormatted } = getLogPath();
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(logFile), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(logFile, [
    '## Backlog', '- **B1:** Ship the report', '',
    '## Inbox', '- **I7:** Read the feedback', '- ordinary note', '',
    '## Completed ✅', '- **C1:** First', '- **C2:** Second',
    '- **C3:** Third', '- **C4:** Fourth', '', '## Notes', 'ignored',
  ].join('\n'));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(root, 'atris', 'lessons.md'),
    '- **Keep:** Useful lesson\nordinary text\n- **Check:** Another lesson\n');
  const lines = capture(t);

  assert.strictEqual(statusAtris(false, true, true), undefined);
  assert.strictEqual(lines.length, 1);
  const output = JSON.parse(lines[0]);
  assert.strictEqual(output.date, dateFormatted);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(output.backlog, [{ id: 'B1', title: 'Ship the report' }]);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(output.inProgress, []);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(output.completed, []);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(output.inbox, [{ id: '7', title: 'Read the feedback' }]);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(output.completions, [
    { id: '2', title: 'Second' },
    { id: '3', title: 'Third' },
    { id: '4', title: 'Fourth' },
  ]);
  assert.strictEqual(output.lessons, 2);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(output.team, []);
});

const { stripeCommand } = require('../commands/stripe');

function captureOutput(run) {
  const logs = [];
  const errors = [];
  const originalLog = console.log;
  const originalError = console.error;
  console.log = (...args) => logs.push(args.join(' '));
  console.error = (...args) => errors.push(args.join(' '));
  try {
    return { status: run(), logs, errors };
  } finally {
    console.log = originalLog;
    console.error = originalError;
  }
}

test('stripe help lists supported commands and installation details', () => {
  const result = captureOutput(() => stripeCommand());

  assert.deepStrictEqual(result.errors, []);

  for (const usage of ['doctor', 'auth', 'listen', 'trigger', 'products list', 'products create']) {
    assert.ok(result.logs.some((line) => line.startsWith(`  ${usage} `)), usage);
  }
  assert.ok(result.logs.includes('binary: stripe'));
  assert.ok(result.logs.includes('install: https://docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli'));
});

class ExitSignal extends Error {
  constructor(code) {
    super(`exit ${code}`);
    this.code = code;
  }
}

// Runs fn with console and process.exit captured. exitCode stays null when the
// command returns without exiting.
async function run(fn) {
  const out = [];
  const err = [];
  const origLog = console.log;
  const origError = console.error;
  const origExit = process.exit;
  console.log = (...parts) => out.push(parts.join(' '));
  console.error = (...parts) => err.push(parts.join(' '));
  process.exit = (code) => {
    throw new ExitSignal(code === undefined ? 0 : code);
  };
  let exitCode = null;
  try {
    await fn();
  } catch (e) {
    if (!(e instanceof ExitSignal)) throw e;
    exitCode = e.code;
  } finally {
    console.log = origLog;
    console.error = origError;
    process.exit = origExit;
  }
  return { exitCode, out: out.join('\n'), err: err.join('\n') };
}

function setEnv(key, value) {
  if (value === undefined) delete process.env[key];
  else process.env[key] = value;
}

function git(cwd, ...args) {
  const result = spawnSync('git', args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 30000 });
  assert.equal(result.error, undefined);
  assert.equal(result.status, 0, result.stderr);
  return result.stdout.trim();
}

function runCommand(args, cwd) {
  const lines = [];
  const originalLog = console.log;
  console.log = (...parts) => lines.push(parts.join(' '));
  let code;
  try {
    code = syncCheckoutCommand(args, cwd);
  } finally {
    console.log = originalLog;
  }
  return { code, lines };
}

let counter = 0;

// Local-only setup: a bare "origin" on disk, a seed clone that pushes to it,
// and a checkout that is one commit behind after a fetch.
function createRepos() {
  counter += 1;
  const base = path.join(sandbox, `case-${counter}`);
  const origin = path.join(base, 'origin.git');
  const seed = path.join(base, 'seed');
  const checkout = path.join(base, 'checkout');
  fs.mkdirSync(seed, { recursive: true });

  git(base, 'init', '--bare', '--initial-branch=master', origin);
  git(seed, 'init', '--initial-branch=master');
  git(seed, 'config', 'user.email', 'test@example.com');
  git(seed, 'config', 'user.name', 'test');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(seed, 'tracked.txt'), 'first\n');
  git(seed, 'add', 'tracked.txt');
  git(seed, 'commit', '-m', 'first');
  git(seed, 'remote', 'add', 'origin', origin);
  git(seed, 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'master');
  git(base, 'clone', origin, checkout);
  git(checkout, 'config', 'user.email', 'test@example.com');
  git(checkout, 'config', 'user.name', 'test');

  return { base, origin, seed, checkout };
}

function pushSeedCommit(seed, content, message) {
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(seed, 'tracked.txt'), content);
  git(seed, 'add', 'tracked.txt');
  git(seed, 'commit', '-m', message);
  git(seed, 'push');
}

test('help flags return 0 and print usage without touching git', () => {
  const missingDir = path.join(sandbox, 'does-not-exist');
  for (const args of [['--help'], ['-h'], ['help'], ['help', 'extra'], ['--dry', '--help']]) {
    const { code, lines } = runCommand(args, missingDir);
    assert.strictEqual(code, 0, `args ${JSON.stringify(args)}`);
    assert.deepStrictEqual(lines, ['usage: atris sync-checkout.']);
  }
});

test('a folder that is not a git checkout is refused with exit 1', () => {
  const plain = path.join(sandbox, 'plain-folder');
  fs.mkdirSync(plain);

  const { code, lines } = runCommand([], plain);
  assert.strictEqual(code, 1);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(lines, [
    'this checkout is not on a git branch; sync-checkout refused to touch it.',
  ]);
});

test('a detached HEAD is refused and the checkout is left alone', () => {
  const { checkout } = createRepos();
  git(checkout, 'checkout', '--detach');
  const before = git(checkout, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD');

  const { code, lines } = runCommand([], checkout);
  assert.strictEqual(code, 1);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(lines, [
    'this checkout is not on a git branch; sync-checkout refused to touch it.',
  ]);
  assert.strictEqual(git(checkout, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), before);
});

test('unstaged and staged tracked edits are refused without moving HEAD', () => {
  for (const staged of [false, true]) {
    const { seed, checkout } = createRepos();
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(checkout, 'tracked.txt'), staged ? 'staged\n' : 'unstaged\n');
    if (staged) git(checkout, 'add', 'tracked.txt');
    pushSeedCommit(seed, 'second\n', 'second');
    const before = git(checkout, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD');

    const { code, lines } = runCommand([], checkout);
    assert.strictEqual(code, 1, `staged=${staged}`);
    assert.deepStrictEqual(lines, [
      'this checkout has tracked changes; sync-checkout refused to touch it.',
    ]);
    assert.strictEqual(git(checkout, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), before);
    assert.strictEqual(
      fs.readFileSync(path.join(checkout, 'tracked.txt'), 'utf8'),
      staged ? 'staged\n' : 'unstaged\n'
    );
  }
});

test('a branch with no upstream is refused with exit 1', () => {
  const { checkout } = createRepos();
  git(checkout, 'checkout', '-b', 'local-only');

  const { code, lines } = runCommand([], checkout);
  assert.strictEqual(code, 1);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(lines, [
    'this checkout has no upstream; sync-checkout refused to touch it.',
  ]);
});

test('a clean checkout fast-forwards to the upstream and reports it', () => {
  const { seed, checkout } = createRepos();
  pushSeedCommit(seed, 'second\n', 'second');
  pushSeedCommit(seed, 'third\n', 'third');
  assert.notStrictEqual(git(checkout, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), git(seed, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'));

  const { code, lines } = runCommand([], checkout);
  assert.strictEqual(code, 0);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(lines, ['this checkout is up to date with origin/master.']);
  assert.strictEqual(git(checkout, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), git(seed, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'));
  assert.strictEqual(fs.readFileSync(path.join(checkout, 'tracked.txt'), 'utf8'), 'third\n');
});

test('untracked files do not block a sync and survive it', () => {
  const { seed, checkout } = createRepos();
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(checkout, 'scratch.txt'), 'mine\n');
  pushSeedCommit(seed, 'second\n', 'second');

  const { code, lines } = runCommand([], checkout);
  assert.strictEqual(code, 0);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(lines, ['this checkout is up to date with origin/master.']);
  assert.strictEqual(fs.readFileSync(path.join(checkout, 'scratch.txt'), 'utf8'), 'mine\n');
  assert.strictEqual(fs.readFileSync(path.join(checkout, 'tracked.txt'), 'utf8'), 'second\n');
});

test('an already current checkout still returns 0 and changes nothing', () => {
  const { checkout } = createRepos();
  const before = git(checkout, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD');

  const { code, lines } = runCommand([], checkout);
  assert.strictEqual(code, 0);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(lines, ['this checkout is up to date with origin/master.']);
  assert.strictEqual(git(checkout, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), before);
});

test('a diverged branch is refused and its local commit is kept', () => {
  const { seed, checkout } = createRepos();
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(checkout, 'local.txt'), 'local work\n');
  git(checkout, 'add', 'local.txt');
  git(checkout, 'commit', '-m', 'local work');
  const localHead = git(checkout, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD');
  pushSeedCommit(seed, 'remote change\n', 'remote change');

  const { code, lines } = runCommand([], checkout);
  assert.strictEqual(code, 1);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(lines, [
    'this checkout could not fast-forward; sync-checkout refused to change it.',
  ]);
  assert.strictEqual(git(checkout, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), localHead);
});

test('a failing fetch is reported and the checkout is not changed', () => {
  const { origin, checkout } = createRepos();
  const before = git(checkout, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD');
  fs.rmSync(origin, { recursive: true, force: true });

  const { code, lines } = runCommand([], checkout);
  assert.strictEqual(code, 1);
  assert.deepStrictEqual(lines, ['this checkout could not sync because git fetch failed.']);
  assert.strictEqual(git(checkout, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), before);
});
'use strict';

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const teach = require('../commands/teach');

function makeTempDir(t, prefix) {
  const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), prefix));
  t.after(() => fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true }));
  return tmp;
}

function chdir(t, dir) {
  const prev = process.cwd();
  process.chdir(dir);
  t.after(() => process.chdir(prev));
}

function captureOutput(t) {
  const logs = [];
  const errs = [];
  const stdout = [];
  const origLog = console.log;
  const origErr = console.error;
  const origWrite = process.stdout.write;
  console.log = (...args) => logs.push(args.join(' '));
  console.error = (...args) => errs.push(args.join(' '));
  process.stdout.write = (chunk) => { stdout.push(String(chunk)); return true; };
  t.after(() => {
    console.log = origLog;
    console.error = origErr;
    process.stdout.write = origWrite;
  });
  return { logs, errs, stdout };
}

test('teach with no atris/teach folder prints a hint and returns 0', (t) => {
  const cwd = makeTempDir(t, 'atris-teach-empty-');
  chdir(t, cwd);
  const { logs, errs } = captureOutput(t);
  const status = teach();
  assert.equal(status, 0);
  assert.deepEqual(logs, ['no atris/teach folder here. add cases under ./atris/teach.']);
  assert.deepEqual(errs, []);
});

  const dir = path.join(cwd, 'atris', 'teach');
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'zebra.md'), 'z');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'alpha.json'), '{}');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'ignored.txt'), 'nope');
  const { logs } = captureOutput(t);
  const status = teach('list');
  assert.equal(status, 0);
  assert.deepEqual(logs, ['cases in atris/teach:', '  alpha', '  zebra']);
});

'use strict';

const { describe, test } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');
const { treeCommand } = require('../commands/tree');

const USAGE = 'usage: atris tree hash [--json]';
const EMPTY_HASH = 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855';

function capture(fn) {
  const logs = [];
  const errors = [];
  const log = console.log;
  const error = console.error;
  console.log = (...args) => logs.push(args.map(String).join(' '));
  console.error = (...args) => errors.push(args.map(String).join(' '));
  try {
    return { code: fn(), logs, errors };
  } finally {
    console.log = log;
    console.error = error;
  }
}

function withTempRoot(fn) {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'atris-tree-command-'));
  const previous = process.cwd();
  process.chdir(dir);
  try {
    return fn(dir);
  } finally {
    process.chdir(previous);
    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

describe('atris tree command', { concurrency: false }, () => {
  test('help prints the usage line and returns 0', () => {
    for (const subcommand of ['help', '--help', '-h']) {
      const result = capture(() => treeCommand(subcommand));
      assert.strictEqual(result.code, 0);
      assert.deepStrictEqual(result.logs, [USAGE]);
      assert.deepStrictEqual(result.errors, []);
    }
  });

  test('an unknown or missing name prints the error and usage and returns 2', () => {
    const named = capture(() => treeCommand('prune'));
    assert.strictEqual(named.code, 2);
    assert.deepStrictEqual(named.errors, ['unknown tree command: prune']);
    assert.deepStrictEqual(named.logs, [USAGE]);

    const missing = capture(() => treeCommand());
    assert.strictEqual(missing.code, 2);
    assert.deepStrictEqual(missing.errors, ['unknown tree command:']);
    assert.deepStrictEqual(missing.logs, [USAGE]);
  });

  test('hash reports the working directory and --json prints the same result', () => {
    withTempRoot((dir) => {
      const empty = capture(() => treeCommand('hash'));
      assert.strictEqual(empty.code, 0);
      assert.deepStrictEqual(empty.errors, []);
      assert.deepStrictEqual(empty.logs, [`${EMPTY_HASH.slice(0, 12)}  0 files`]);

      fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'atris', 'skills', 'demo'), { recursive: true });
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'atris.md'), 'doctrine\n');
      fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'atris', 'skills', 'demo', 'SKILL.md'), 'skill\n');

      const plain = capture(() => treeCommand('hash', 'ignored'));
      const json = capture(() => treeCommand('hash', 'ignored', '--json'));
      assert.strictEqual(plain.code, 0);
      assert.strictEqual(json.code, 0);
      assert.deepStrictEqual(plain.errors, []);
      assert.deepStrictEqual(json.errors, []);

      const parsed = JSON.parse(json.logs[0]);
      assert.strictEqual(parsed.schema, 'atris.tree_hash.v1');
      assert.strictEqual(parsed.files, 2);
      assert.strictEqual(parsed.short, parsed.hash.slice(0, 12));
      assert.notStrictEqual(parsed.hash, EMPTY_HASH);
      assert.deepStrictEqual(parsed.manifest.map((file) => file.path), [
        'atris.md',
        'atris/skills/demo/SKILL.md',
      ]);
      assert.deepStrictEqual(plain.logs, [`${parsed.short}  ${parsed.files} files`]);
    });
  });

  test('hash returns 1 when a doctrine path cannot be read', () => {
    withTempRoot((dir) => {
      fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'atris.md'));
      const result = capture(() => treeCommand('hash'));
      assert.strictEqual(result.code, 1);
      assert.deepStrictEqual(result.logs, []);
      assert.strictEqual(result.errors.length, 1);
      assert.match(result.errors[0], /^tree hash failed: /);
    });
  });
});
'use strict';

const test = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const os = require('node:os');
const path = require('node:path');

const { truthCommand } = require('../commands/truth');

function makeWorkspace() {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'atris-truth-cmd-test-'));
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(dir, 'atris'), { recursive: true });
  return dir;
}

function writeFeature(dir, name, { status, proofAgeDays } = {}) {
  const fdir = path.join(dir, 'atris', 'features', name);
  fs.mkdirSync(fdir, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(fdir, 'validate.md'), `status: ${status}\n`, 'utf8');
  if (proofAgeDays != null) {
    const proofDir = path.join(fdir, 'proof');
    fs.mkdirSync(proofDir, { recursive: true });
    const receipt = path.join(proofDir, 'receipt.md');
    fs.writeFileSync(receipt, 'proof\n', 'utf8');
    const when = new Date(Date.now() - proofAgeDays * 86400000);
    fs.utimesSync(receipt, when, when);
  }
}

// Run truthCommand inside `dir` with HOME and the task db pointed at temp
// paths, capturing console.log/console.error. Returns { code, out, err }.
function runTruth(dir, args) {
  const prevCwd = process.cwd();
  const prevHome = process.env.HOME;
  const prevDb = process.env.ATRIS_TASKS_DB;
  const prevState = process.env.ATRIS_TEST_STATE_DIR;
  const prevLog = console.log;
  const prevErr = console.error;
  const out = [];
  const err = [];
  console.log = (...a) => out.push(a.join(' '));
  console.error = (...a) => err.push(a.join(' '));
  let code;
  try {
    process.chdir(dir);
    process.env.HOME = dir;
    process.env.ATRIS_TEST_STATE_DIR = dir;
    process.env.ATRIS_TASKS_DB = path.join(dir, 'tasks.db');
    code = truthCommand(args);
  } finally {
    console.log = prevLog;
    console.error = prevErr;
    process.chdir(prevCwd);
    if (prevHome === undefined) delete process.env.HOME; else process.env.HOME = prevHome;
    if (prevDb === undefined) delete process.env.ATRIS_TASKS_DB; else process.env.ATRIS_TASKS_DB = prevDb;
    if (prevState === undefined) delete process.env.ATRIS_TEST_STATE_DIR; else process.env.ATRIS_TEST_STATE_DIR = prevState;
  }
  return { code, out: out.join('\n'), err: err.join('\n') };
}

test('truth renders workspace report for an empty atris workspace', () => {
  const dir = makeWorkspace();
  try {
    const { code, out } = runTruth(dir, []);
    assert.equal(code, 0);
    assert.match(out, /ATRIS TRUTH/);
    assert.match(out, /Scope: workspace/);
    assert.match(out, /Missions active: 0/);
    assert.match(out, /Feature lanes \(0\)/);
    assert.match(out, /Loops \(0\)/);
  } finally {
    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});

test('truth --json dedupes missions, filters closed ones, and verdicts features by proof age', () => {
  const dir = makeWorkspace();
  try {
    const stateDir = path.join(dir, '.atris', 'state');
    fs.mkdirSync(stateDir, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(
      path.join(stateDir, 'missions.jsonl'),
      [
        JSON.stringify({ id: 'm1', status: 'active', owner: 'devin' }),
        'not json',
        JSON.stringify({ mission_id: 'm2', status: 'blocked' }),
        JSON.stringify({ id: 'm1', status: 'complete' }),
        JSON.stringify({ id: 'm3', status: 'stopped' }),
      ].join('\n') + '\n',
      'utf8',
    );

    writeFeature(dir, 'fresh', { status: 'in progress', proofAgeDays: 0 });
    writeFeature(dir, 'old', { status: 'in progress', proofAgeDays: 30 });
    writeFeature(dir, 'idea', { status: 'draft' });
    writeFeature(dir, 'jammed', { status: 'blocked on review' });
    writeFeature(dir, '_scratch', { status: 'in progress' });

    const { code, out } = runTruth(dir, ['--json']);
    assert.equal(code, 0);
    const result = JSON.parse(out);

    assert.equal(result.ok, true);
    assert.equal(result.scope.kind, 'workspace');

    const missionIds = result.missions_active.map((m) => m.id).sort();
    assert.deepEqual(missionIds, ['m2']);

    const rows = Object.fromEntries(result.feature_rows.map((f) => [f.lane, f.verdict]));
    assert.equal(rows.fresh, 'proven');
    assert.equal(rows.old, 'stale');
    assert.equal(rows.idea, 'unproven');
    assert.equal(rows.jammed, 'blocked');
    assert.equal(rows._scratch, undefined);
    assert.equal(result.features.proven, 1);
    assert.equal(result.features.stale, 1);
    assert.equal(result.features.unproven, 1);
    assert.equal(result.features.blocked, 1);
  } finally {
    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});

test('truth --json verdicts workspace loops from dated log lines', () => {
  const dir = makeWorkspace();
  try {
    const loopsDir = path.join(dir, 'atris', 'loops');
    fs.mkdirSync(loopsDir, { recursive: true });
    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(loopsDir, 'alive.md'), `# alive\n\n- ${today}: tick\n`, 'utf8');
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(loopsDir, 'dead.md'), '# dead\n\n- 2020-01-01: tick\n', 'utf8');
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(loopsDir, 'fresh.md'), '# fresh\n\nno runs yet\n', 'utf8');
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(loopsDir, 'LOOPS.md'), '# index\n\n- 2020-01-01: ignored\n', 'utf8');

    const { code, out } = runTruth(dir, ['--json']);
    assert.equal(code, 0);
    const result = JSON.parse(out);

    const rows = Object.fromEntries(result.loop_rows.map((l) => [l.id, l.verdict]));
    assert.equal(rows.alive, 'proven');
    assert.equal(rows.dead, 'stale');
    assert.equal(rows.fresh, 'never-ran');
    assert.equal(rows.LOOPS, undefined);
  } finally {
    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});

test('truth refuses with code 2 in a scratch folder that has no atris/ tree', () => {
  const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'atris-truth-scratch-'));
  try {
    const { code, err } = runTruth(dir, []);
    assert.equal(code, 2);
    assert.match(err, /account-global; pass --account to continue/);
  } finally {
    fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
});
const { test } = require('node:test');
const assert = require('node:assert');
const { vercelCommand } = require('../commands/vercel');

function captureOutput(run) {
  const stdout = [];
  const stderr = [];
  const originalLog = console.log;
  const originalError = console.error;
  console.log = (...args) => stdout.push(args.join(' '));
  console.error = (...args) => stderr.push(args.join(' '));
  try {
    return { status: run(), stdout: stdout.join('\n'), stderr: stderr.join('\n') };
  } finally {
    console.log = originalLog;
    console.error = originalError;
  }
}

test('vercel without arguments prints its supported commands and installation help', () => {
  const result = captureOutput(() => vercelCommand());

  assert.strictEqual(result.status, 0);
  assert.strictEqual(result.stderr, '');
  assert.match(result.stdout, /usage: atris vercel <command> \[args\]/);
  for (const command of ['doctor', 'auth', 'deploy', 'ls', 'logs', 'inspect']) {
    assert.match(result.stdout, new RegExp(`^  ${command} +\\S`, 'm'));
  }
  assert.match(result.stdout, /--raw +print the full cli output instead of the grouped summary/);
  assert.match(result.stdout, /^binary: vercel$/m);
  assert.match(result.stdout, /^install: https:\/\/vercel\.com\/docs\/cli$/m);
});

const test = require('node:test');
